newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka gains on liquidity crunch.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka gains on liquidity crunch.

text.p: A shortage in bank liquidity helped Bangladesh taka to close firmer at 42.5460/5470 to the dollar, compared with the previous close of 42.5465/5480, dealers said.
The local unit quoted in a wide range at 42.5460/5490 per dollar in early trade but edged up on poor dollar demand.

"Banks were busy investing the local currency in a liquid-scarce market," said one dealer. Some banks faced liquidity shortfall after they bought the central bank treasury bills worth 1.53 billion taka last week. Call money was traded between 8.0 and 9.0 percent, up from Thursday's 8.0-8.5 percent, dealers said. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
